metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in Egypt's Toshka Lakes decrease in June 2012 compared to September 2002?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use JRC Global Surface Water Monthly History (JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory) for September 2002 and June 2012 over a polygon covering Egypt’s Toshka Lakes (approx 30.1E–30.9E, 22.4N–23.4N). If empty, fall back to Landsat 5/7 L2, same monthly window.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- JRC GSW is preprocessed (no cloud handling needed; set Cloud% = 0).
- Landsat fallback: mask clouds/shadows using QA_PIXEL bits; compute NDWI and threshold > 0.2; estimate cloud% as masked fraction relative to total pixels at 1 km.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- C1: image collection size 0 even after fallback.
- C2: validCount == 0 (no valid pixels after masking/processing).
- C3: area result is null/NaN/invalid.
- Otherwise, compare water area (km²): if 2012 < 2002 => A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  var geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[[30.1, 22.4], [30.9, 22.4], [30.9, 23.4], [30.1, 23.4], [30.1, 22.4]]], null, false
  );
  var period1 = {year: 2002, month: 9};   // September 2002
  var period2 = {year: 2012, month: 6};   // June 2012

  function monthDateRange(y, m) {
    var start = ee.Date.fromYMD(y, m, 1);
    var end = start.advance(1, 'month');
    return {start: start, end: end};
  }

  // 2. Metrics functions
  function metricsFromGSW(y, m, geometry) {
    var dr = monthDateRange(y, m);
    var col = ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory')
      .filterDate(dr.start, dr.end);
    var size = col.size();
    var img = ee.Image(col.first());
    var base = ee.Dictionary({source: 'GSW1_4', images: size, cloudPct: 0});
    return ee.Algorithms.If(
      size.gt(0),
      ee.Dictionary(function() {
        var waterBand = img.select('water');
        // Mask out NoData (0); valid pixels are >0
        var validMask = waterBand.gt(0);
        var validCount = waterBand.updateMask(validMask)
          .reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry: geometry,
            scale: 1000,
            maxPixels: 1e13
          }).get('water');
        // Water class == 2
        var waterMask = waterBand.eq(2);
        var waterCount = ee.Image(1).updateMask(waterMask).rename('w')
          .reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry: geometry,
            scale: 1000,
            maxPixels: 1e13
          }).get('w');
        var areaM2 = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(waterMask).rename('area')
          .reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry: geometry,
            scale: 1000,
            maxPixels: 1e13
          }).get('area');
        return base.set({
          validCount: validCount,
          waterCount: waterCount,
          area_m2: areaM2
        });
      }()),
      base.set({validCount: null, waterCount: null, area_m2: null})
    );
  }

  // Landsat fallback (L5/L7 L2)
  function cloudMaskL57(img) {
    var qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    var dilated = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).neq(0);
    var cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).neq(0);
    var cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0);
    var shadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0);
    var mask = dilated.or(cirrus).or(cloud).or(shadow).not();
    return img.updateMask(mask);
  }
  function scaleSR57(img) {
    var scaled = img.select(['SR_B2', 'SR_B4'], ['green', 'nir'])
      .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
      .copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
    return scaled.addBands(img.select(['QA_PIXEL'])).updateMask(scaled.mask());
  }
  function metricsFromLandsat(y, m, geometry) {
    var dr = monthDateRange(y, m);
    var l5 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2')
      .filterDate(dr.start, dr.end)
      .filterBounds(geometry);
    var l7 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2')
      .filterDate(dr.start, dr.end)
      .filterBounds(geometry);
    var col = l5.merge(l7).map(scaleSR57).map(cloudMaskL57);
    var size = col.size();
    var base = ee.Dictionary({source: 'Landsat57_L2', images: size});
    return ee.Algorithms.If(
      size.gt(0),
      ee.Dictionary(function() {
        var composite = col.median();
        var ndwi = composite.normalizedDifference(['green', 'nir']).rename('ndwi');
        var waterMask = ndwi.gt(0.2);
        var ndwiValidCount = ndwi.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: geometry,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e13
        }).get('ndwi');
        var totalCount = ee.Image(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: geometry,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e13
        }).get('one');
        var cloudPct = ee.Number(1)
          .subtract(ee.Number(ndwiValidCount).divide(ee.Number(totalCount)))
          .multiply(100);
        var waterCount = ee.Image(1).updateMask(waterMask).rename('w').reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: geometry,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e13
        }).get('w');
        var areaM2 = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(waterMask).rename('area')
          .reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry: geometry,
            scale: 1000,
            maxPixels: 1e13
          }).get('area');
        return base.set({
          validCount: ndwiValidCount,
          waterCount: waterCount,
          area_m2: areaM2,
          cloudPct: cloudPct
        });
      }()),
      base.set({validCount: null, waterCount: null, area_m2: null, cloudPct: null})
    );
  }

  function monthlyMetricsWithFallback(y, m, geometry) {
    var gsw = ee.Dictionary(metricsFromGSW(y, m, geometry));
    var useFallback = ee.Number(gsw.get('images')).eq(0);
    return ee.Dictionary(ee.Algorithms.If(
      useFallback,
      metricsFromLandsat(y, m, geometry),
      gsw
    ));
  }

  var stats = ee.Dictionary({
    p1: monthlyMetricsWithFallback(period1.year, period1.month, geom),
    p2: monthlyMetricsWithFallback(period2.year, period2.month, geom)
  });

  stats.evaluate(function(res) {
    try {
      function toNum(x) { return (x === null || x === undefined) ? null : Number(x); }
      var p1 = res.p1, p2 = res.p2;

      // Evidence print (concise)
      function printLine(label, p) {
        var imgs = toNum(p.images);
        var vc = toNum(p.validCount);
        var wc = toNum(p.waterCount);
        var area_km2 = (p.area_m2 == null) ? null : (Number(p.area_m2) / 1e6);
        var cloud = (p.cloudPct == null) ? 'NA' : Number(p.cloudPct).toFixed(1);
        console.log(label + " Source: " + p.source + ", Images: " + imgs +
          ", ValidPix: " + vc + ", WaterPix: " + wc +
          ", Water_km2: " + (area_km2 == null ? "null" : area_km2.toFixed(2)) +
          ", Cloud%: " + cloud);
      }
      printLine("2002-09", p1);
      printLine("2012-06", p2);

      // Core checks
      if (toNum(p1.images) === 0 || toNum(p2.images) === 0) {
        console.log("C1");
        return;
      }
      if (toNum(p1.validCount) === 0 || toNum(p2.validCount) === 0) {
        console.log("C2");
        return;
      }
      var a1 = toNum(p1.area_m2);
      var a2 = toNum(p2.area_m2);
      if (a1 == null || a2 == null || !isFinite(a1) || !isFinite(a2) || a1 < 0 || a2 < 0) {
        console.log("C3");
        return;
      }

      var area1_km2 = a1 / 1e6;
      var area2_km2 = a2 / 1e6;
      var ratio = (area1_km2 > 0) ? (area2_km2 / area1_km2) : null;
      console.log("Areas km2 -> 2002-09: " + area1_km2.toFixed(2) + ", 2012-06: " + area2_km2.toFixed(2));
      if (ratio !== null && isFinite(ratio)) {
        console.log("2012/2002 ratio: " + ratio.toFixed(3));
      }

      // Final Answer
      if (area2_km2 < area1_km2) {
        console.log("A");
      } else {
        console.log("B");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.log("D");
    }
  });
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
